api_usage_limit.description: (Optional) The percentage of your Salesforce [daily API limit](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.salesforce_app_limits_cheatsheet.meta/salesforce_app_limits_cheatsheet/salesforce_app_limits_platform_api.htm) that Fivetran should consume. Value must be between 50 and 90 (default value = `90`)

base_url.description: (Optional) The custom Salesforce domain. Make sure that the `base_url` starts with `https://`.

certificate.description: Provide content of the `.pem` certificate (only when authentication_method = `ADVANCED`).

private_key.description: Provide content of the `.key` private key (only when authentication_method = `ADVANCED`).

sync_formula_fields.description: Enable this option to sync formula fields directly (default value = `false`)

update_infrequent_objects_in_every_sync.description: Enable this option to sync infrequently updated tables during every sync (default value = `false`)

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your Salesforce client application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your Salesforce client application.

refresh_token.description: The long-lived `Refresh token` along with the `client_id` and `client_secret` parameters carry the information necessary to get a new access token for API resources.
